overview-njals-dasent1861.title: Anonymous, The Story of Burnt Njal, trans. George Webbe Dasent (1861), chapter-text online

overview-njals-manuscripts2018.title: Svanhildur Oskarsdottir and Emily Lethbridge, eds., New Studies in the Manuscript Tradition of Njals saga (2018)
overview-njals-manuscripts2018.notes: Medieval and modern copies, variant witnesses and complex reception; not a single stable oral performance.

overview-njals-andersson2006.title: Theodore M. Andersson, The Growth of the Medieval Icelandic Sagas (2006)
overview-njals-andersson2006.notes: Historical development of sagas 1180-1280 and their engagement with political and legal problems; interpretive scholarship.

overview-njals-wiki.title: Wikipedia: Njals saga
overview-njals-wiki.notes: Orientation only; source-specific narrative and history claims use Dasent and scholarship.

overview-pedro-elem.title: Enciclopedia de la Literatura en Mexico: Pedro Paramo, editions, textual history and critical essays
overview-pedro-elem.notes: Publication 1955, fragments, multiple dates, narrative architecture; quotes from the novel not reproduced. This is critical secondary evidence, not complete primary-text collation.

overview-pedro-harvard-review.title: Daniel Rey, Pedro Paramo: review of the Douglas J. Weatherford translation, Harvard Review
overview-pedro-harvard-review.notes: Plot and interpretive orientation; English edition 2023. Claims about the novel should be confirmed in a licensed primary edition before deep close reading.

overview-pedro-cambridge.title: Jason Wilson, Pedro Paramo by Juan Rulfo, in The Cambridge Companion to the Latin American Novel
overview-pedro-cambridge.notes: 1955 and literary reception, distinctions between Rulfo and later Boom; not a primary narrative witness.

overview-pedro-sincronia.title: Ramon Barcenas Deanda, El encuentro enigmatico de Juan Preciado con la pareja de hermanos en Pedro Paramo, Sincronia (2019)
overview-pedro-sincronia.notes: Explains competing interpretations of the Donis/sister encounter, including Rulfo interview attribution; do not flatten its ambiguous status.

overview-dede-dresden.title: SLUB Dresden, Kitab-i Dedem Korkut: manuscript contents and twelve plot synopses
overview-dede-dresden.notes: Institutional custodian outline of the Dresden prologue and twelve tales; narrations are original synopsis-led retellings. Full original-language manuscript/English critical translation not collated for this pass.

overview-dede-utexas1972.title: Sümer, Uysal, Walker, The Book of Dede Korkut: A Turkish Epic (University of Texas Press, 1972)
overview-dede-utexas1972.notes: Copyrighted English critical edition with chapter list, no translated text reproduced and full contents were not directly inspected.

overview-dede-tdk.title: Turkish Language Association, Reading problems in manuscripts of oral literary works: Dede Korkut
overview-dede-tdk.notes: Dresden prologue and twelve tales, Vatican prologue and six tales; textual differences, language layering and editorial issues.

overview-dede-unesco.title: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage: Heritage of Dede Qorqud / Korkyt Ata / Dede Korkut
overview-dede-unesco.notes: Living traditions and musical/storytelling cultures; separate from medieval Dresden textual witness.

overview-lusiads-original.title: Luís de Camões, Os Lusíadas (1572), public-domain Portuguese text, Project Gutenberg #3333
overview-lusiads-original.notes: Original Portuguese verse, ten cantos; primary canto locators for all narrative and critical claims.

overview-lusiads-burton1.title: Richard Francis Burton, The Lusiads (1880), volume I, cantos I–VI
overview-lusiads-burton1.notes: Named public-domain English witness with arguments to each canto and notes; used for episode checking, not copied.

overview-lusiads-burton2.title: Richard Francis Burton, The Lusiads (1880), volume II, cantos VII–X
overview-lusiads-burton2.notes: Canto arguments and verse allow direct verification of Calicut, banners, Island of Love, World Machine, ending.

overview-lusiads-columbia.title: Columbia University, World Epics: Camões, Os Lusíadas
overview-lusiads-columbia.notes: Critical reading of epic form and the limits of Da Gama at Calicut; section may occasionally be unavailable.

overview-lusiads-uw.title: University of Washington Classics seminar: Pious Dissent in The Lusiads
overview-lusiads-uw.notes: Scholarly discussion of Old Man of Restelo speech and possible anti-imperial dissent; interpretation debated, not established authorial policy.

overview-lusiads-geo.title: Cartographic Curses: Europe and the Ptolemaic Poetics of Os Lusíadas (scholarly chapter)
overview-lusiads-geo.notes: Historical cartography and representation of oceans; do not claim present-day accuracy of poem’s cosmology.

overview-lusiads-wooster.title: College of Wooster, Luis Vaz de Camoes, The Lusiads: early modern imperial source
overview-lusiads-wooster.notes: Sixteenth-century expansionist worldview and depicted non-European peoples; a primary poem is not neutral colonial history.

overview-lusiads-wiki.title: Wikipedia: Os Lusíadas
overview-lusiads-wiki.notes: Orientation only; the epic’s primary evidence is Portuguese original and Burton English version.

overview-huaro-utexas.title: Frank Salomon and George L. Urioste, The Huarochirí Manuscript: A Testament of Ancient and Colonial Andean Religion (1991), University of Texas Press
overview-huaro-utexas.notes: English edition with Quechua transcription, scholarly introduction and notes; publisher description and contents used to identify editions and episodes, not independently collated in full. No wording reproduced.

overview-huaro-jstor.title: Salomon and Urioste, The Huarochirí Manuscript, JSTOR bibliographic record and chapter contents
overview-huaro-jstor.notes: Cross-checks divisions, chapter themes, transmission and scholarly edition; not evidence of line-by-line collation.

overview-huaro-spanish.title: Huarochirí manuscript, Spanish-language public rendering and chapter excerpts
overview-huaro-spanish.notes: Used only to corroborate episode order and details. This public Spanish-language witness is not verified against a critical Quechua transcription and is not presented as an original or independent definitive translation.

overview-huaro-durston.title: Alan Durston, Cristóbal Choquecasa, autor del Manuscrito de Huarochirí (2024), PUCP
overview-huaro-durston.notes: Identifies a reasoned argument that Choquecasa authored/redacted the surviving manuscript; an attribution proposal, not a universally settled fact.

overview-huaro-2025.title: Figuring Pre-colonial Andean Narratives: Toribio Mejía Draws the Huarochirí Manuscript (2025)
overview-huaro-2025.notes: Discussion of early colonial textual transmission and later visual reception; explicitly states no consensus regarding single Choquecasa authorship.

overview-huaro-herring.title: Adam Herring, Speaking Pebble: A Word–Image from Huarochirí, Peru, 1608 (2025), Word & Image
overview-huaro-herring.notes: Reconsiders multilayered authorship and indigenous informant collaboration; scene-level treatment of Macahuisa at Inca court.

overview-huaro-bnp.title: Biblioteca Nacional del Perú, Ecos de Huarochirí
overview-huaro-bnp.notes: Context on translation and literary reception, including twentieth-century Indigenous and Peruvian scholarship.

overview-huaro-wiki.title: Wikipedia: Huarochirí Manuscript
overview-huaro-wiki.notes: Quick orientation only; detailed claims rely on identified textual witnesses and scholarship.

overview-gawain-bl.title: British Library, Cotton MS Nero A X/2: Pearl, Cleanness, Patience, and Sir Gawain and the Green Knight
overview-gawain-bl.notes: Unique surviving medieval copy of the poem, folios 94v–130r, copied c.1375–1400; dates and locale of scribal copy are not a proven author biography.

overview-gawain-weston.title: Jessie L. Weston, Sir Gawain and the Green Knight, public-domain 1898 prose retelling, Robbins Library Digital Projects
overview-gawain-weston.notes: Read as complete public-domain narrative witness; Weston selectively omits or interprets the original (especially hunting technicalities). New lecture is original prose, not a reproduction.

overview-gawain-stanford.title: Stanford Arthurian Literature, Sir Gawain and the Green Knight: introductory outline
overview-gawain-stanford.notes: Supports the four fitts, 2530-line alliterative form and bob-wheel, the interlocking beheading, exchange and temptation games, and interpretive questions.

overview-gawain-mets.title: Middle English Text Series: Gawain romance general introduction
overview-gawain-mets.notes: Context for the medieval Arthurian Gawain tradition and chivalric reputation; not the only textual witness.

overview-gawain-wiki.title: Wikipedia: Sir Gawain and the Green Knight
overview-gawain-wiki.notes: Listener orientation only; line-level and historical claims use the named text and scholarship.

overview-rubaiyat-1859.title: Edward FitzGerald, Rubáiyát of Omar Khayyám, 1859 first edition, complete 75 numbered quatrains, Wikisource first-edition transcription
overview-rubaiyat-1859.notes: The full English poem was directly checked by quatrain number. This is FitzGerald’s first edition, not a Persian original or a critical edition of independently authenticated Khayyam verses.

overview-rubaiyat-sep.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, Umar Khayyam (revised 2023; archive 2024)
overview-rubaiyat-sep.notes: Supports the historical polymath’s mathematics, philosophy, poetic themes and scholarly context; does not establish authorship for every later quatrain.

overview-rubaiyat-iranica-translation.title: Encyclopaedia Iranica, Khayyam, Omar iv: English Translations of the Rubaiyat
overview-rubaiyat-iranica-translation.notes: Discusses independent Persian quatrains versus the FitzGerald unified poetic structure, Ouseley and Calcutta source manuscripts, and free adaptation; search view consulted, full page timed out.

overview-rubaiyat-iranica-fitz.title: Encyclopaedia Iranica, Edward FitzGerald
overview-rubaiyat-iranica-fitz.notes: Supports first 1859 English edition, subsequent revisions in 1868, 1872, 1879, and Victorian influence.

overview-rubaiyat-iranica-west.title: Encyclopaedia Iranica, Khayyam Omar iii: Impact on Literature and Society in the West
overview-rubaiyat-iranica-west.notes: Context for the pamphlet’s early slow sales, Pre-Raphaelite interest and subsequent anglophone literary reception.

overview-rubaiyat-iranica-art.title: Encyclopaedia Iranica, illustrations of English Rubaiyat translations
overview-rubaiyat-iranica-art.notes: Illustration tradition and uncertainty of Persian manuscript attributions; the artwork is not reproduced.

overview-rubaiyat-wiki.title: Wikipedia: Rubaiyat of Omar Khayyam
overview-rubaiyat-wiki.notes: Quick listener orientation only; edition/attribution claims rely on the named first edition and scholarly resources.
